_readme: TEMPLATE ONLY. Copy the providers you choose into ../.mcp.json. Secrets come from environment variables (set them in your shell or a git-ignored .env) — never paste keys here. Verify each provider's current setup docs before enabling. Use sandbox/test credentials first and read-only scopes where offered.

stripe._docs: https://docs.stripe.com/mcp — OAuth via `claude /mcp`, or an Agent API key. From 2026-10-31 only Agent keys or OAuth are accepted.

quickbooks._docs: https://github.com/intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server — local server, OAuth app credentials from the Intuit developer portal. Check the repo README for the exact start command and env var names.

xero._docs: Official xero-mcp-server (self-hosted). Uses a Xero custom connection or OAuth app. Check its README for the package name and env vars.

hq._docs: OUR OWN server (handoff.md §11.3) — does not exist yet. Read-only first; runs with the signed-in user's permissions.
